summary: Cloudflare Worker plate-docs at plateprocess.dev serves docs bundled from a release-tagged checkout and exposes read-only MCP list_docs, get_doc, and search_docs; manual wrangler deploy only.
migration_impact: No adopter repo changes in this slice; operators deploy by hand from a release tag checkout.
agent_notes: No version URL prefixes; release tag is chosen at npm run bundle time. No CI deploy workflow or Cloudflare secrets in repo.
